name: Fevertree Drinks PLC
summary: Fevertree Drinks PLC, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development and sale of mixer drinks in the United Kingdom, the United States, Europe, and internationally. The company offers tonics, soft drinks, non-alcoholic, sodas, gingers, ready to drink, cocktail mixers, and cola and lemonades. It sells its products under the Fever-Tree brand name. The company was formerly known as Fevertree Topco Limited and changed its name to Fevertree Drinks PLC in October 2014. Fevertree Drinks PLC was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in London, United Kingdom.
